history.summary: Large 1819 sqft 4BR in D05 West Coast at $1748 PSF — 8% below the $1900 resale median — on a near-perpetual 999yr lease, with a solid 5.76% URA resale CAGR (41 txns). One-North/TEL proximity supports the area, but the low PSF is partly the function of an oversized unit and the $3.18M quantum thins the buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Frontier entry (Elo 1718, on_frontier) with genuine value: $1748 PSF vs $1900 median (41 resale txns) on 999yr tenure that behaves like freehold. 5.76% resale CAGR is RCR-baseline-grade and credible. Build-quality reviews are mixed (rusting gates, average finishes), and at $3.18M the 4BR exits to a narrower pool — but the discount, near-freehold tenure and One-North/Clementi location make this a solid investment hold.
red_flags: Mixed build quality — rusting metalwork and average interior finishes per reviews
$3.18M quantum sits above the deepest $1.8-2.5M buyer band
Low PSF partly reflects an oversized 1819 sqft unit, not pure underpricing
catalysts: One-North tech-hub and TEL/Clementi connectivity demand
999yr tenure preserves value vs ageing 99yr peers
